newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Medical cutting 225 jobs, sets charge.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Medical cutting 225 jobs, sets charge.

text.p: Advanced Medical Inc., a maker of intravenous pumps and other medical equipment, said Tuesday it will cut 225 jobs as part of a restructuring and take an unspecified charge in the fourth quarter.

In a statement, the San Diego-based company said the move reflected its recent acquisition of IVAC Medical Systems Inc. It said it has begun to cut staffing in the combined company to 1,375 employees from about 1,600.

"The restructuring will have the greatest impact on corporate staff and manufacturing, since the companies were practically mirror images of each other," William Mercer, president and chief executive officer.
About 125 jobs were eliminated Tuesday and another 100 jobs will be phased out over the next six months, it said.

The company also said it will consolidate its two disposable device manufacturing facilities in Tijuana, Mexico, in the second half of 1997. The facilities employ more than 1,100 contract workers, and the company said it was examining various manufacturing alternatives in Tijuana.
The company said it was continuing to explore alternatives for a Japanese partner, and was expanding in Asia and Latin America.
Advanced Medical stock added 50 cents to $3.875 on the American Stock Exchange, where it was one of the biggest gainers on the day.
